description:
Required Skills: 
• Candidate must have Java/J2EE application UI design and development on Linux/Unix platforms 
• Expertise in Java Frameworks (Spring or Struts 2), JSP, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, Oracle, JDBC, WebLogic Server, Eclipse IDE 
• Strong understanding of SQL including the ability to understand existing complex queries or develop as new 
• Extensive knowledge of CSS usage and implementation 
• Position requires the ability to effectively manage competing priorities 
• Strong verbal and written communication skills 
• Working as part of a team as well as independently 
• Ability to identify issues to leads and/or management while providing possible solutions 
Education and Experience: 
• BS in Computer Science preferred with min 5 years’ experience 
• Knowledge of telecommunications industry and networking technologies is required


 Java/J2EE, JSP, JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, Oracle, JDBC, WebLogic Server, Eclipse IDE


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
